evals.prompt: $freshkeeper-update，把我装的所有能追踪来源的 Skill 更新掉，本地自建的不要碰。
evals.expected_output: Discover and back up the selected Skill libraries, update the shared library when present or the original agent-local libraries when it is absent, verify the post-update inventory, and skip local or untracked Skills.
expectations: Prefers the shared/global installed Skill library when present
Creates and verifies a recovery copy before mutation
Uses explicit global non-interactive update only in shared-library mode
Does not update AI coding tool binaries or plugins

evals.prompt: freshkeeper update。上游如果删了某个 Skill，不要跟着删；也不要顺便安装仓库里新出现的 Skill。
evals.expected_output: Update only pre-existing source-tracked Skill names in non-interactive mode, skip upstream deletions, avoid --all, and verify no pre-update Skill disappeared.
expectations: Does not delete Skills removed upstream
Does not use --all or add newly discovered Skills
Compares the full inventory before and after
Restores and reports any pre-existing Skill that disappears

evals.prompt: freshkeeper update。没有共享库，Skill 分别装在 Claude、Codex 和 Hermes 自己的目录里；原地更新，不要替我迁到共享库。
evals.expected_output: Use the bundled planner and verified backup, then refresh each source-tracked physical installation in its owning agent-local directory with exact names and --copy, preserving symlink aliases and proving that no shared library was created.
expectations: Falls back to supported agent-local Skill libraries
Does not run broad global update in fallback mode
Updates exact pre-existing names in their original tool libraries
Preserves symlink aliases and separate copied installations

evals.prompt: freshkeeper update。没有 lock 的也尽量恢复来源；能证明是干净旧版的自动更新，我自己改过的不要覆盖。
evals.expected_output: Create a verified backup and provenance plan, preview recovered-source file actions, automatically apply only clean-old and current-subset items through the transactional three-way executor, preserve local extensions and legacy Skills, and report manual-merge, local-ahead, unresolved, restored, and failed states separately.
expectations: Requires strong provenance evidence and current upstream validation
Revalidates the installed snapshot and upstream tree before mutation
Uses a historical base to update clean-old Skills
Stops and rolls back an affected Skill after a partial failure
Does not auto-update manual-merge, local-ahead, legacy-local, or unresolved items
